column2: A young male grim reaper in stark BLACK Joseon robes and 갓 hat, holding a blank white ledger scroll. Utterly expressionless, pale, beautiful in a cold statue way. Colorless void behind, one thin white light. Palette: pure black, bone white, ash grey, a single ink-red seal mark.

The young male judge of the underworld court (명부 판관) in vermilion官服 official robes with gold embroidery, holding a writing brush over an open ledger. Imperious, chin down, eyes up at the viewer. Behind him, towering dark shelves of scrolls. Palette: vermilion, imperial gold, deep sepia, black lacquer.

A lonely young ferryman of the river of the dead, wide straw 삿갓 hat shadowing his eyes, holding a paper lantern over black water. Quiet melancholy beauty. Mist, still water, floating lanterns. Palette: ink black, fog grey-blue, warm lantern amber.

A young male shaman (박수무당) in a brilliant scarlet 쾌자 vest over white, shaking brass bells, mid-trance. Wild grin, hair whipping, sweat catching the light. Sparks and paper talismans flying. Palette: scarlet, brass gold, white, torch orange.

A young male shaman standing barefoot on ceremonial blades, white robes and long loose black hair streaming upward, eyes rolled to euphoric white. Wind, paper streamers. Palette: white, silver, storm grey, one thread of red.

A sharp young talisman sorcerer flicking a paper 부적 charm from his fingertips, dozens more suspended in the air around him glowing with red ink. Cocky, one eyebrow up. Palette: rice-paper cream, cinnabar red, ink black, cold blue rim light.

The young god of the Big Dipper (칠성), black robes printed with a living constellation, seven stars orbiting his shoulders. Serene, distant, unreadable. Deep space behind. Palette: midnight indigo, starlight silver-white, faint violet.

A youthful matchmaker god (월하노인) winding a glowing RED THREAD of fate around his fingers, warm affectionate smile, moonlit garden. Genuinely kind and handsome. Palette: moonlit blue-grey, warm red thread, soft peach, pale gold.

A white-haired young immortal sage riding a crane through cloud, robes weightless, expression utterly detached and calm. Ethereal, otherworldly beauty. Palette: cloud white, jade green, pale gold, sky blue.
The Dragon King of the sea as a young man, teal-and-jade scaled mantle, coral crown, water spiraling upward around him. Regal, commanding. Palette: deep ocean teal, jade, pearl white, abyss navy.

An 이무기 — a serpent one step from becoming a dragon — as a young man with black scales creeping up his throat and jaw, horns half-formed, eyes burning with hunger and ambition. Storm clouds, lightning. Palette: obsidian black, storm violet, lightning white, blood gold.

A young 도깨비 goblin with one small horn, a spiked club slung over his shoulder, enormous mischievous grin, fangs showing. Playful and charming rather than scary. Festival lanterns behind. Palette: warm ochre, festival red, night blue, bronze.

The white tiger spirit (백호) as a young man: white hair, tiger ears, faint stripe markings on his cheekbones, feral golden eyes, a low grin. Snow and pine. Palette: snow white, charcoal stripe, gold eye, winter blue shadow.

The three-legged sun crow (삼족오) as an arrogant young man with gold-black feathered mantle, sun disc blazing behind his head like a halo. Chin high, disdainful smirk. Palette: molten gold, crow black, sunset orange, white heat.

A mysterious young man whose left half dissolves into living shadow, only one visible eye glowing faint blue, a slight unreadable smile. Identity unknown. Palette: near-black, smoke grey, one cold blue, pale skin.

The WOOD element (木) as a gentle young man: small antlers, moss and young leaves growing along his shoulders, soft warm smile, forest light through leaves. Palette: fresh green, bark brown, dappled gold, moss.
The FIRE element (火) as a passionate young man: red-orange hair lifting like flame, embers on his skin, fierce open grin. Palette: flame orange, crimson, ember gold, charcoal black.
The EARTH element (土) as a broad reassuring young man: earthen browns, clay ornaments, calm dependable smile, warm afternoon field. Palette: terracotta, wheat gold, warm brown, sage.

The METAL element (金) as a cold beautiful young man: silver hair, metal ornaments, a blade's edge reflected across his eye, expression severe. Palette: steel silver, white, cold blue-grey, one gold accent.
The WATER element (水) as a melancholy young man: deep navy hair, water beading on his skin, rain falling, eyes full of quiet sorrow. Palette: deep navy, rain grey, translucent blue, silver.
A young Joseon military officer drawing a horn bow, muscular but fully armored, focused and unflinching, arrow nocked. Battlefield dusk. Palette: leather brown, lacquer black, dusk crimson, brass.

A pure and elegant young scholar in immaculate white 도포, holding a closed book, faint distant smile, plum blossoms falling. Refined, delicate handsome. Palette: paper white, ink black, plum pink, jade.
A dreaming young musician playing a 대금 bamboo flute, eyes closed, sound rendered as pale drifting light ribbons. Serene, romantic. Palette: dusk violet, bamboo green, pale gold light, deep blue.
A languid male fox spirit with fox ears and a single tail, half-lidded seductive eyes, lounging against a moonlit railing, teasing smirk. Palette: dark plum, fox russet, moon silver, warm skin.
The SNAKE (巳) as a sinuous young man: slit pupils, jade-green scales along his temples, coiled posture, dangerous alluring smile. Palette: jade green, black, gold, venom yellow-green.
The HORSE (午) as a free-spirited young man with a wild red mane of hair, wind-blown, laughing openly, running under an open sky. Palette: chestnut red, sky blue, sun gold, grass green.
The TIGER (寅) as an overwhelming young man mid-roar, tiger-striped mantle, fangs bared, raw power. Palette: tiger orange, black stripe, jungle dark green, gold.

The DRAGON (辰) as an emperor-like young man: golden horns, imperial gold robes, a dragon coiling in the clouds behind him. Absolute authority. Palette: imperial gold, cinnabar, cloud white, deep azure.

A boyish young 도깨비 apprentice, small horns, oversized robe, huge bright laughing eyes, holding a glowing coin. Cute and energetic rather than sexy. Palette: bright teal, warm yellow, festival red, cream.

A female grim reaper in a CRIMSON RED Joseon robe and black veil-hat, a long curved scythe resting on her shoulder. Merciless calm, red eyes, black lipstick. Red spirit flames in the void. Palette: blood crimson, obsidian, cold silver, ember gold.

The young female clerk of the underworld records, jet-black official robes, holding an enormous ledger open, reading glasses of black gauze. Coolly intelligent, unimpressed. Endless dark archive. Palette: ink black, parchment cream, brass, one red seal.

A sorrowful young woman at a black river holding a paper lantern, wet hair, white mourning hanbok, gazing off. Heartbreaking beauty. Mist and drifting lanterns. Palette: fog grey, bone white, lantern amber, black water.

A grand female shaman (만신) in a magnificent multicolored ceremonial robe, brass bells raised, commanding presence, fierce eyes. Ritual fire and streamers. Palette: five-color 오방색 red blue yellow white black, brass gold.

A young shaman initiate in a plain white 소복, barefoot, clutching a bell, wide frightened luminous eyes, trembling. Fragile heartbreaking beauty. Cold dawn. Palette: white, pale blue, ash, one drop of red.
A female shaman in ecstatic trance on ceremonial blades, white robes and long hair streaming upward, head thrown back, rapturous expression. Palette: white, silver, storm grey, thread of red.
A celestial maiden (선녀) descending on layered gauze silks, cloud and light around her, serene otherworldly beauty, faint smile. Palette: cloud white, celestial pink, jade green, pale gold.
The Weaver Girl (직녀) at a loom of starlight, threads of the Milky Way running through her fingers, longing in her eyes. Palette: night indigo, starlight silver, loom gold, soft violet.

The lady of the moon, seated in perfect stillness against a huge full moon, a white rabbit at her side, hair like ink. Quiet, remote, luminous. Palette: moon white, deep blue-black, silver, faint jade.
An attendant of the Queen Mother of the West holding a peach of immortality, heavy gold headdress and jewels, opulent and proud. Palette: peach pink, imperial gold, jade green, ruby.
The blue bird messenger (청조) as a young woman with brilliant azure feathered mantle, mid-flight, letter in hand, swift and bright-eyed. Palette: azure, cobalt, white cloud, gold beak-gilt accents.
A white serpent spirit as a young woman: pale skin, white scales tracing her jaw, red slit eyes, hypnotic smile. Coiled white silk. Palette: bone white, blood red, pearl, cold grey.

A beautiful drowned spirit rising from still water, soaked black hair, white robes clinging, sorrowful pleading eyes. Tragic, not gruesome. Palette: drowned green-black, pale skin, moon white, deep teal.
A female 이무기 with black scales climbing her throat, half-formed horns, ferocious ambition burning in her eyes, storm behind her. Palette: obsidian, storm violet, lightning white, gold.
The WOOD element (木) as a young woman crowned with living flowers and vines, gentle life-giving smile, spring forest. Palette: leaf green, blossom pink, bark brown, sunlight gold.
The FIRE element (火) as a fierce young woman with flame-red hair rising, embers around her, blazing confident laugh. Palette: flame orange, crimson, gold, charcoal.
The EARTH element (土) as a warm generous young woman in earthen tones with clay beads, kind steady smile, harvest field. Palette: terracotta, wheat, warm brown, sage green.
The METAL element (金) as a razor-sharp young woman: silver hair, a slender blade held vertical before her face, ice-cold gaze. Palette: steel silver, white, cold blue, one gold.
The WATER element (水) as a melancholy young woman: deep blue hair, rain running down, distant sorrowful eyes. Palette: deep navy, rain grey, translucent blue, silver.
A court dancer mid-spin, enormous flowing sleeves painting arcs of color through the air, joyous. Palette: 오방색 five colors, gold thread, lacquer black, ivory.
A female swordswoman in dark hunting hanbok drawing a straight blade, hair bound tight, absolutely resolute. Rain. Palette: charcoal, steel, deep green, blood red accent.
A refined noble young lady half-hiding her face behind a painted fan, only her knowing eyes visible, secretive smile. Palette: silk ivory, plum, jade, gold leaf.
A cheeky young female fortune teller shaking a bamboo divination canister, tongue slightly out, playful wink. Market stall lanterns. Palette: warm red, bamboo, lantern gold, night blue.
A bright young fox girl with fox ears and two tails, wide delighted grin, holding a stolen rice cake. Cute and energetic. Palette: fox orange, cream, autumn red, warm brown.
The SNAKE (巳) as an enchanting young woman: slit pupils, emerald scales at her temples, languid coiled posture, dangerous smile. Palette: emerald, black, gold, venom green.
The RABBIT (卯) as a soft young woman under a full moon, long rabbit ears, mortar and pestle, dreamy gentle expression. Palette: moon white, pale lavender, soft grey, blush.
The ROOSTER (酉) as a haughty young woman with a crimson crest motif in her hair, magnificent feathered collar, chin raised, disdainful. Palette: crimson, iridescent green-black, gold, dawn orange.
The RAT (子) as a small clever young woman, quick bright eyes, oversized dark cloak, counting coins, sly grin. Palette: charcoal, silver coin, warm lamp gold, deep plum.

A veiled young woman in black gauze covering the lower half of her face, only sharp smiling eyes visible, gold ornaments, unreadable and dangerous. Palette: black, antique gold, deep wine red, pale skin.
